# Governing Thought

A single seed artifact is sufficient to fire the cascade end-to-end.

## MECE Support

1. The cascade pipeline accepts any markdown file under a section as a trigger.
2. Edge-count assertions are NOT this fixture's job (see cascade-e2e/seed-room/).
3. Surface-shape assertions are this fixture's only job.
